articles.summary: Following the recent executive order directing the expedited rescheduling of cannabis from Schedule I to Schedule III, the industry has reached its largest federal policy milestone in cannabis in 50 years since prohibition. However, even with this historic momentum, it is critical for stakeholders to understand that rescheduling is an administrative process—not immediate legalization.

articles.summary: Scaling a cannabis brand isn’t like scaling traditional CPG. Every new state brings new rules, partners, and economics—making copy-and-paste expansion impossible. At Hall of Flowers, Nabis Co-CEO Jun Lee joined Embarc’s Dustin Moore and Equity Trade Network’s Ramon Garcia to break down what it really takes to grow into a multi-state cannabis brand. From choosing the right operational partners to navigating hidden market barriers, prioritizing specialization, and building for future interstate commerce, this conversation reveals the hard-earned strategies every cannabis operator needs before expanding into new markets.
articles.title: The Hard Truth About Expanding Your Cannabis Brand Into New States
